notes.title: 📣🎮 Demo Gamepad Support is finally here!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 
I hope you had the happiest holidays, and I whish you a happy New Year's Eve and a Happy 2025! ✨

The demo update is finally out! As mentioned in a previous announcement, there's no new content in this update (no new customers, food, decor). Here's a little breakdown of the main changes:
[list]
[*][b]Controller support[/b]: You can now play the demo with your Xbox or PlayStation controllers! And also play on Steamdeck! Other controllers (like the Switch Pro Controller) are still under testing - if you try any out and find a bug, please report it!
[*][b]UI changes[/b]: Some UIs have been updated to fit the gamepad experience, such as the Options menu.
[*][b]Camera shake fix [i]attempt[/i][/b]: The way the camera moves has been reworked in an attempt to avoid the uncontrollable shaking some users were experiencing. None of the testing machines can reproduce this issue. If you still encounter this issue after the update please report it so I can keep working on it.
[*][b]Other tiny bug fixes and technical stuff[/b] (not very interesting, such as geometry rendering wrongly, UX fixes, etc.
[/list]

💌 Please let me know your thoughts on the new demo or any suggestions you have.

Before I sign off, one more fun announcement:
Nom Nom: Cozy Forest Café won [b]MOST ADORABLE CAFE SIMULATOR[/b] at TGAGWCAGA 2024 event, which showcased a TON of awesome indie games.
[b]You can see the Showcase [url=https://youtu.be/prrLRWxntgg?si=ps3thJxDan8FJAC3]here[/url]![/b]

As always thank you for your support!!
- Anaïs

notes.title: Nom Nom is part of TGAGWCAGA 2024! + Next update info
notes.content:
I'm so excited to announce that Nom Nom: Cozy Forest Café will be part of [b]TGAGWCAGA 2024[/b], or [b]The Game Awards for Games Who Can't Afford the Game Awards[/b] this Friday, December 13th!

TGAGWCAGA is a brand new showcase designed to spotlight incredible indie games that truly deserve more attention—while also poking a bit of fun at the exclusivity of The Game Awards.

Where to watch:
TGAGWCAGA 2024
Friday, December 13th 
5:00 PM UTC / 6:00 PM CET / 12:00 PM ET
Watch the stream here: https://www.youtube.com/@TGAGWCAGA

We'll also be part of the Steam Event running from December 13th to December 22nd, featuring the games on the showcase.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Next update info:[/h2]
I've been working on controller support and some bug fixes for the current uploaded demo. This means there will be an update but content will not be added - instead, some interfaces and controls have been reworked. 

Hopefully this fixes any issues you've encountered while trying the demo. I'll make an update announcement when it's up!

Before I go, I wanted to take a minute to thank you for your patience. Making a game is a massive task and I'm working mostly alone. I know you are excited for the game to release and I'm so happy we are nearing 40k wishlists. I also know I do not update you as much as I'd like to. It's very touching to me that you are still here and support me through it. Every time I get sick, the development is slightly delayed. Every time someone in my family needs my support, the development is slightly delayed. Every time I need a break, the development gets slightly delayed. Yet so many of you are still here. Thank you. 
❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

See you at TGAGWCAGA this friday!

notes.title: NEW DEMO is LIVE NOW!
notes.content:
🥰 Hi everyone!
As promised, after the Indie Dev Day event in Barcelona, 🔔[b]the DEMO is now LIVE for everyone to try out![/b]🔔

🍴 In this Demo you can only cook for one customer (randomly chosen between Mooon, Mlem and Vori), but I've included the option to prepare takeaways at the vending machine so you can try out up to 4 different recipes (boba, nom sticks, coffee and cookies). 
🛋️ There's also a pool of decoration items and all the colours and finishes are unlocked so you can play with the decoration system! Keep in mind that every time you load the game, the save data will be reset and a random customer will be chosen, so you can meet all three of them.

Giving you a taste of what I'm cooking here is very exciting for me!😏 The full game will have 10 customers, 10 recipes, more furniture options and more mini-games (that you have not seen yet)! 
🐖🦔🦫🦈🧁🍮🍹✂️🧸🧶🖌️

I'm setting up a discussion thread so you can share your thoughts and feedback on the demo. If you have any questions about the state of development, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2428800/announcements/detail/4667507375039075724]please read this post first[/url]!

Have fun playing!

notes.title: Development update 📢 New demo in October + IndieDevDay Barcelona
notes.content:
Hello everyone. I wanted to share some updates on the development of the game and some exciting news.

[b]DEMO live in OCTOBER:[/b]
A new demo will go live next month. I can't wait for you all to check it out. 

If you had a chance to play the first demo last year, I think you will be pleasantly surprised at how things have developed. I listened to your feedback and changed a lot of things, especially the decoration system and controls, which was a bit clunky at the time. For the demo, [b]4 of the 10 food rhythm/decoration mini-games[/b] will be available for you to try, and [b]some of the furniture and painting options will be unlocked[/b]. This [b]DEMO requires mouse control[/b]. Steamdeck and controller support are on the roadmap but not yet developed. Please bear in mind that I'm making the game [u]on my own[/u], so things are moving slowly... but steadily!

[b]INDIE DEV DAY BARCELONA:[/b]
I will be at Indie Dev Day in Barcelona with the demo from the 27th to the 29th of September, so if you are visiting you get the chance to play before it goes live on Steam! + Please come say hi!

[b]THE PUBLISHER / CONSOLE RELEASE SITUATION:[/b]
On a less happy note, the game's former publisher and I parted ways in June. This means that the previously announced [u]ports for all other platforms (Mobile, Switch, XBOX, PS) are currently on hold[/u]. 

It makes me extremely sad to communicate this but I wanted you to be aware of the current situation. Please know that I will be looking for a new suitable partner to help me realise these versions!

This situation has also affected development times as I have had to deal with *that* on a personal and professional level and now have a slightly higher workload. I humbly ask for your patience while I finish the game and sort things out. I'm working very hard on Nom Nom!🥺

💖 Thank you for sticking around! Please come back next month, I'd love to hear your feedback on the new demo! 💖
